clips.meaning: Quiet attentive breathing, alternating ear twitches and a slow tail sway.
Looks down at the sketchbook and draws a craft pattern with several short pencil strokes.
Raises both paws clearly above shoulder level, displaying the sketchbook and pencil during one delighted hop, then returns to rest.
Raises the sketchbook toward its face and reads it with a pronounced downward gaze and slow page scan; pencil hand stays resting.
A small inquisitive look-around: base swivel and two opposing shade tilts.
Lowers the visible stylus onto its fixed circular guide and traces two back-and-forth arcs while the shade aims at the pad. No new marks are generated.
Stretches into a proud upright pose and gives two delighted shade nods before folding back.
Leans toward the work pad and makes a broad slow inspection sweep, unlike the short repetitive tracing state.
Friendly attentive body rock with tools held at waist height and both feet planted.
Raises the circuit workpiece toward the face and leans forward to inspect it while the probe hand rests.
Uses repeated short probe strokes toward the waist-held circuit guide while the left arm steadies it; guide marks remain fixed.
Raises both tools above shoulder level with one cheerful hop and a preparatory knee bend.

cost.local_compute: Existing host only; electricity and hardware depreciation not measured

limits_of_claim: Weft frozen importer accepted both bundles, but actual simulation pose alignment/display/replay remains unverified and belongs to the integration session.
Neutral body transforms, target axes and scale are an explicitly user-authorized authoring proposal, not recovered Weft state.
All models use stylized intersecting closed primitives with rigid-part weights, not guaranteed manifold manufacturing meshes, fur, realistic anatomy, smooth skin or cloth.
Model byte-level rebuild reproducibility is not guaranteed; immutable accepted originals and exact source artifacts are retained.
No seamless loop is certified; endpoint equality does not prove velocity continuity.
Visual review is sampled agent inspection, not human approval or every-frame playback.
Original reference rights, exact source prompts and original rig are unavailable; metadata is provenance only.
Initial full media runs predate the separate packaging worker. A real full-length lamp clip and all four short robot clips verify its bounded path separately.
The final Muse default equals the measured full-export settings; larger overrides may hit bounds rather than complete.
next_safe_action: Use the reusable skill for new text requests in new output folders. Weft owner may consume the immutable model/mapping paths and verify actual neutral/articulated alignment without changing physics.
scope: Agent-assisted text-to-scene authoring, local real rigged GLB/.blend, native reload, 2D media, material skins and provisional Weft mapping; no standalone neural prompt model or physics simulator

unit_tests.fixtures: Analytic fixtures are not counted as authored examples
